sources.title: Queue Imbalance as a One-Tick-Ahead Price Predictor in a Limit Order Book
sources.finding: Across ten Nasdaq stocks, queue imbalance predicts the direction of the next midpoint change; improvement is larger in large-tick stocks.
sources.application_limit: Different markets and target. It does not establish profit after our delayed IOC fills, ten-second hold, and costs.

sources.title: Latency and liquidity provision in a limit order book
sources.finding: Order flow after market orders passes through distinct phases; some observations support stimulated refill and some do not.
sources.application_limit: Refill and reversal should be measured on these venues instead of assumed from a large print.

research_implication: Candidate future measurements: executable-side quote movement, refill persistence, and queue imbalance. No active batch rule or threshold changed. This record was made before batch economic evaluation.
